name: order-game
title: Order Game
description: Put a handful of items in order: events from earliest to latest, places from smallest to largest. The player drags rows by their handle, or moves them with the arrow keys or the up and down buttons, then locks in. The rows then glide into the right order…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/order-game

Installed to `components/ui/games/order-game.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/order-game';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/order-game

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
